mode.instructions: Which review lens fits this request?

criteria.code-review: Find defects in concrete source code or a diff
criteria.design: Evaluate an architecture, API or design proposal
criteria.analysis: A general question or analysis that is neither

contradicts.instructions: Does statement B contradict statement A, or replace it with a different value, about the same subject?

criteria.true: B contradicts A or replaces it with a different value
criteria.false: B agrees with A, adds to it, or is about something else
